sloka: ततस्तं प्रस्थितं सीता वीक्षमाणा पुनः पुनः ।भर्तृस्नेहान्वितं वाक्यं हनुमन्तमभाषत ।। 5.56.2 ।।।।
transliteration: tatastaṁ prasthitaṁ sītā vīkṣamāṇā punaḥ punaḥ ।bhartṛsnehānvitaṁ vākyaṁ hanumantamabhāṣata ।। 5.56.2 ।।।।

translations.english: Looking at Hanuman again and again, as he was ready to start on his return journey, thus spoke Sita expressing her love for her husband:
